metadata.description: Agent skills for using kubuszok's Scala libraries (Hearth, Kindlings, ...) - one plugin per library.

plugins.name: hearth
plugins.description: Skills for writing Scala 2.13/3 macros with Hearth: cross-quotes, MIO, CaseClass/Enum, type class derivation, standard extensions, debugging.

plugins.name: kindlings
plugins.description: Skills for using Kindlings: type class derivation for circe, jsoniter-scala, cats, avro, pureconfig, tapir, yaml, xml, scalacheck and more, plus di, mock, optics and parser modules.

plugins.name: sbt-kubuszok
plugins.description: Skills for adopting the sbt-kubuszok sbt plugin: what it already configures (git versioning, Maven Central publishing, ci-release, scalafmt), build layout with projectType/Aliases/DevProperties, GitHub Actions CI and release workflows, and troubleshooting failed publishes.
